scheduled_availability.evidence: A settlement date is public at a decision instant only if the calendar of its year was already published at that instant, and the only evidence of when is the Internet Archive's captures of SIFMA's page (data/sifma-wayback-1276/manifest.json) and of one workbook (data/sifma-wayback-1276-workbooks/manifest.json), which `public_from` below lists by year with the capture's timestamp (UTC, as the archive stamps it) and what in the capture shows the year's calendar. A year whose calendar no capture shows has `null`: none of its dates is public at any instant (the indicator is 0), and nothing is guessed. A year with a capture is public from the capture's instant, so a date of that year that falls before the capture is not public either (every decision that can target it was made before the capture). The block's `days: 1` and `available_time` are the earliest the registry's shape can say (a decision reads a date the business day before it at 16:00, the published records' decision time); the per-year `public_from` is the stricter, and it is the one the code applies (repo_model.sifma_mbs.public_at). The declared dates read by a decision are all later than the capture, so a calendar read at lead 2 to 5 is as public as one read at lead 1: the code applies the same per-date rule at every lead.
scheduled_availability.note: 16:00 is the published records' decision time. The captures' timestamps are the earliest instants the archive proves the calendar was public, not the instants SIFMA published it, which were earlier: the declaration is therefore conservative in the direction of not reading a date.

rule: A date `d` of class `k` is read as 1 by a decision made at instant `I` (16:00 America/New_York on the decision day) when `d` is in the table and `public_from[year(d)]` is not null and is at or before `I`; otherwise it is read as 0. A forecast of target day `T` at lead `h` is made on the decision `h` panel rows before `T`; a training pair reads the indicator of its own target row at the decision `h` rows before it. Nothing else is read: no date from a later capture, no date of a year that has none, and no stale date in place of a missing one.

coverage: agency MBS class A to D settlement dates
